fields.label: Post Costs to General Ledger
fields.description: When enabled, submitting a Fuel Log, Maintenance Log, Truck Expense, or Tyre Retread will automatically create and submit a Journal Entry.

fields.label: Default Payment/Credit Account
fields.description: e.g. Cash, Bank, or a Creditors account. This is credited on every auto-posted entry.

fields.label: Minimum Legal Tread Depth (mm)
fields.description: Used by Tyre Depth Inspection to auto-flag a Fail. Kenyan traffic law sets 1.6mm as the general minimum, though your fleet may hold itself to a stricter internal standard (e.g. 3mm on steer axles) - adjust to whatever policy applies.

fields.label: Alert Days Before Expiry
fields.description: Daily background job checks Insurance/License/Inspection/COMESA expiry dates on all active Trucks and notifies this many days in advance.

fields.label: M-Pesa Account (for M-Pesa payments)
fields.description: The ledger account representing your M-Pesa till/paybill float.

fields.label: Enable Live M-Pesa B2C Disbursement
fields.description: Requires Safaricom Daraja B2C API access approved for your shortcode, and a Security Credential generated via the Daraja portal. Leave off to just record M-Pesa payments manually (transaction code field).

fields.label: Result URL
fields.description: https://your-site/api/method/transport_logistics.transport_logistics.mpesa.b2c_result_callback

fields.label: Queue Timeout URL
fields.description: https://your-site/api/method/transport_logistics.transport_logistics.mpesa.b2c_timeout_callback

fields.label: Default Workshop Warehouse
fields.description: Spare parts are issued from this warehouse when a Workshop Job Card is completed. Leave blank to skip stock movement and only track cost.

fields.label: Fuel Stock Asset Account
fields.description: Used for bulk fuel purchase/dispensing GL postings. WARNING: if your Company already has Perpetual Inventory accounting enabled for the fuel Item, do NOT also enable GL posting here for Bulk Fuel Purchase/Fuel Dispensing — ERPNext's own Stock Entry accounting would already post these, and enabling both will double-count. Choose one.

fields.label: Clearing & Forwarding Billing Item
fields.description: A generic service Item (e.g. 'Clearing & Forwarding Services') used as the line item when generating a Sales Invoice from a Shipment's billable charges — ERPNext requires every invoice line to reference a real Item.

fields.label: Enable Live GPS Sync
fields.description: Pulls live positions from your GPS tracking platform on a schedule and updates each enabled Truck's location and odometer. Also turn on 'Track this Truck via GPS' on the individual Truck records you want synced.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Traccar is fully supported today (a free, self-hosted or cloud GPS platform, traccar.org). iSpy Africa and Safetrac are listed as options but NOT yet wired up — their fetch functions in gps_tracking.py are stubs, since neither publishes a public API reference. Selecting one of them will fail sync attempts with a clear error until a developer implements the fetch function using API details obtained directly from that vendor.

fields.label: Server URL
fields.description: Base URL of your Traccar server, no trailing slash. e.g. https://track.yourcompany.com

fields.label: Reject Odometer Jump Above (Km)
fields.description: If a device's odometer reading jumps by more than this many Km since the last sync, it is treated as a device glitch/reset and ignored (logged to Error Log) rather than applied to the Truck. The odometer is also never allowed to move backward.

fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Integration
fields.description: Requires a Meta Business + WhatsApp Business Platform app (business.facebook.com) with a registered phone number and a permanent access token. All sending is best-effort: a failed WhatsApp send is logged to WhatsApp Message Log and never blocks the document that triggered it.

fields.label: Phone Number ID
fields.description: From your WhatsApp Business Platform app's Cloud API dashboard, not the phone number itself.

fields.label: WhatsApp Business Account ID
fields.description: Optional — only needed for managing Message Templates via the API. Not required for sending or receiving messages.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: Use a permanent System User token from a Meta Business integration — the default 24-hour test token will stop working after a day.

fields.label: Default Country Code
fields.description: Digits only, no '+'. A phone number entered starting with a single '0' (e.g. 0712345678) has the '0' replaced with this code before sending.

fields.label: Internal Alerts (breakdowns, accidents, expiry, compliance)
fields.description: Sent alongside the existing in-app Notification/ToDo, to every enabled user holding the Notify Role, using each User's Mobile No.

fields.label: Driver-Facing (trip dispatch, Authority to Load result, fuel confirmation)
fields.description: Sent to the driver's Employee Cell Number.

fields.label: Customer-Facing (Shipment status updates)
fields.description: Sent to the WhatsApp Number set on the Shipment. Off by default — turn on once you've confirmed customers are comfortable receiving WhatsApp updates.

fields.label: Webhook Verify Token
fields.description: Any string you choose — enter the same value in Meta's webhook subscription setup. Webhook URL: https://your-site/api/method/transport_logistics.transport_logistics.whatsapp.webhook

fields.label: Test Number
fields.description: Enter a WhatsApp number (with or without country code) and use the 'Send Test Message' button in the toolbar.

fields.label: Enable Email Alerts
fields.description: Sends alerts as email using this site's own outgoing Email Account (Settings > Email Account) via frappe.sendmail() — no separate SMTP credentials needed here. All sending is best-effort: a failed email is logged to Error Log and never blocks the document that triggered it.

fields.label: Internal Alerts (breakdowns, accidents, expiry, compliance)
fields.description: Sent alongside the existing in-app Notification/ToDo, to every enabled user holding the Notify Role, using each User's email address.

fields.label: Driver-Facing (trip dispatch, Authority to Load result, fuel confirmation)
fields.description: Sent to the driver's Employee Company Email (falling back to Personal Email if Company Email is blank).

fields.label: Customer-Facing (Shipment status updates)
fields.description: Sent to the Client Email set on the Shipment. Off by default — turn on once you've confirmed customers are comfortable receiving email updates.

fields.label: Test Recipient
fields.description: Enter an email address and use the 'Send Test Email' button in the toolbar.

fields.label: Enable SMS Alerts
fields.description: Requires an Africa's Talking account (africastalking.com) with an SMS application. All sending is best-effort: a failed SMS is logged to SMS Message Log and never blocks the document that triggered it.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Only Africa's Talking is wired up today. Listed as a Select (rather than hardcoded) so another gateway can be added to sms.py later without a Settings schema change.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Use 'sandbox' for the free Africa's Talking sandbox environment, or your live app's username in Production.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: From Africa's Talking dashboard: Account > API Key.

fields.label: Sender ID / Shortcode
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to send from Africa's Talking's shared/default sender in Sandbox. A registered Sender ID or shortcode is required for Production in most cases.

fields.label: Internal Alerts (breakdowns, accidents, expiry, compliance)
fields.description: Sent alongside the existing in-app Notification/ToDo, to every enabled user holding the Notify Role, using each User's Mobile No.

fields.label: Driver-Facing (trip dispatch, Authority to Load result, fuel confirmation)
fields.description: Sent to the driver's Employee Cell Number.

fields.label: Customer-Facing (Shipment status updates)
fields.description: Sent to the Client WhatsApp Number set on the Shipment (reused here as a plain phone number for SMS). Off by default.

fields.label: Test Number
fields.description: Enter a phone number (with or without country code) and use the 'Send Test SMS' button in the toolbar.
